archetype: ARCHETYPE 2: THE PERFORMANCE PRO & INDUSTRIAL PRECISION
theme_strategy: Industrial Slate & Tactical High Contrast (Dark Navy Sidebar + Crisp Clean Content canvas with Slate / Dark Mode Toggle)

admin.name: Administrator (Kepala Bengkel / Supervisor)
admin.permissions: Full CRUD access, edit schedules, edit sparepart inventory, update technician assignments, view financial cost reports, approve digital signatures.

user.name: Operator / User (Teknisi / Operator Pabrik)
user.permissions: Read-only access, complete maintenance check forms, capture digital signature for proof, CANNOT view financial/cost data.

key_features_and_views.title: Halaman Login & Switch Role Demo
key_features_and_views.description: Form login modern dengan pemilih role cepat (Admin vs User) untuk pengujian instan, indikator kredensial preset, dan backdrop visual pabrik.

key_features_and_views.title: Ringkasan Dashboard (Analitik Utama)
key_features_and_views.description: Statistik KPI utama (Total Mesin, Mesin Beroperasi, Pemeliharaan Jatuh Tempo, Sparepart Menipis, Total Biaya Servis - disembunyikan untuk User), Grafik Status Mesin (Recharts), Grafik Biaya Bulanan, List Jadwal Mendesak.

key_features_and_views.title: Manajemen Mesin
key_features_and_views.description: Tabel & Grid Katalog Mesin Industri (Kode Mesin, Nama, Lokasi Line, Spesifikasi, Status Operasional, Riwayat Singkat). Admin memiliki Modal Tambah/Edit/Hapus Mesin.

key_features_and_views.title: Jadwal Pemeliharaan (Preventive Maintenance)
key_features_and_views.description: Kalender dan Daftar Jadwal Perawatan Preventif harian/mingguan/bulanan. Status: Terjadwal, Dalam Proses, Selesai, Terlambat. Admin dapat membuat jadwal baru & assign teknisi.

key_features_and_views.title: Manajemen Sparepart & Stok
key_features_and_views.description: Daftar Inventaris Suku Cadang Mesin, Stok Minimal dengan Alert Otomatis (Low Stock Warning), Harga per unit (Admin only), Lokasi Rak. Admin dapat update stok & restock.

key_features_and_views.title: Manajemen Teknisi
key_features_and_views.description: Profil Teknisi Pabrik, Spesialisasi (Listrik, Mekanik, Hidrolik), Status Kehadiran/Tugas Saat Ini, Kontak, dan Jumlah Work Order Selesai.

key_features_and_views.title: Perbaikan & Riwayat Servis
key_features_and_views.description: Log Riwayat Perbaikan Mesin & Servis Berkala per Mesin. Detail kerusakan, tindakan perbaikan, sparepart yang diganti, durasi downtime, teknisi penanggung jawab, serta cetak bukti kerja.

key_features_and_views.title: Laporan & Analisa
key_features_and_views.description: Analisis Efisiensi & Breakout Biaya Servis, Chart Tren Kerusakan Mesin, Filter Berdasarkan Periode & Lokasi Line, serta Tombol Ekspor PDF / Print Laporan.

key_features_and_views.title: Form Tanda Tangan Digital (Bukti Selesai Preventif/Perbaikan)
key_features_and_views.description: Canvas Tanda Tangan Interaktif untuk Operator & Teknisi setelah pekerjaan selesai, dilengkapi Checklist Verifikasi Pekerjaan, Foto Bukti, dan Generasi Dokumen BAP (Berita Acara Pemeliharaan).

component_guidelines.signature_canvas: Use HTML5 Canvas or react-signature-canvas pattern to allow smooth mouse/touch signing for both Operator and Technician with Clear and Confirm buttons.
component_guidelines.role_toggle_banner: Provide a quick floating or top bar role switcher ('Aktifkan Mode: Admin / User') so users and reviewers can seamlessly test Admin privilege controls and User read-only restrictions.
component_guidelines.data_testids: All buttons, inputs, tables, role switches, signature canvases, and export buttons MUST have explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='role-toggle-admin', data-testid='signature-operator-canvas', data-testid='export-pdf-button', data-testid='add-machine-button').
component_guidelines.charts: Use Recharts / Shadcn Chart components with custom tooltip formatting in IDR (Rupiah) for financial graphs (visible only in Admin mode) and operational counts.
component_guidelines.modals: Use Shadcn Dialog for add/edit operations, ensure focus trapping, clear labels, and primary buttons in blue/slate.
component_guidelines.toasts: Use Sonner for operational feedback (e.g., 'Mesin berhasil ditambahkan', 'Jadwal pemeliharaan telah diperbarui', 'Tanda tangan berhasil disimpan').

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is written in natural, clean Bahasa Indonesia appropriate for an industrial manufacturing plant.

Strictly enforce Role-Based Access: In 'User' mode, edit buttons must be disabled or hidden, and cost information (harga sparepart, total biaya servis, estimasi biaya) MUST show as '*** (Akses Terbatas)' or be completely hidden.
Make sure the digital signature component allows clear drawing with mouse or touch screen, clear canvas button, and saves signature as data URL into the service report.

Include sample seed data in Bahasa Indonesia for machines (e.g., CNC Milling Deckel Maho, Compressor Screw Atlas Copco, Boiler Stoker 10 Ton, Injection Molding KraussMaffei), spareparts (O-Ring Viton, Bearing SKF 6205, Hydraulic Oil ISO VG 48, Filter Udara Heavy Duty), and technicians (Budi Santoso - Lead Mekanik, Agus Setiawan - Teknisi Listrik, etc.).
Ensure the layout is highly responsive and clean with a dark tactical left sidebar, crisp white/slate main content cards, clear badges, and high accessibility contrast.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, tab, card, and form element.
